#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <queue>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const string BAD = "VK";
const string STR = "VKA";
const int INF = 1000000;

string prepare(const string& s) {
    string sb;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == 'V' || c == 'K') {
            sb += c;
        } else {
            sb += 'A';
        }
    }
    return sb;
}

int fast(const string& s) {
    string ps = prepare(s);
    int n = ps.length();
    
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> sz(3, 0);
    vector<vector<int>> pos(3, vector<int>(n));
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3, vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(3)));
    vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int c;
        if (ps[i] == 'V') c = 0;
        else if (ps[i] == 'K') c = 1;
        else c = 2;
        a[i] = c;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            cntHere[c][sz[c]][k] = pref[i][k];
        }
        pos[c][sz[c]] = i;
        sz[c]++;
        
        pref[i + 1] = pref[i];
        pref[i + 1][c]++;
    }
    
    int sz0 = sz[0], sz1 = sz[1], sz2 = sz[2];
    // dp[last][j0][j1][j2]
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, 
        vector<vector<vector<int>>>(sz0 + 1, 
            vector<vector<int>>(sz1 + 1, 
                vector<int>(sz2 + 1, INF))));
    
    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
    int ans = INF;
    
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz0; j0++) {
        for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz1; j1++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz2; j2++) {
                for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                    int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                    int cur = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                    if (cur == INF) continue;
                    
                    if (idx == n) {
                        ans = min(ans, cur);
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    if (j0 < sz0) {
                        int cost = max(j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                        dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], cur + cost);
                    }
                    
                    if (j1 < sz1 && last == 0) {
                        int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                        dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], cur + cost);
                    }
                    
                    if (j2 < sz2) {
                        int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0) + max(j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                        dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], cur + cost);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int ignore;
    cin >> ignore; // first integer is ignored
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    cout << fast(s) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
